title: Persistent Depth Ordering amid Shifting Block-Bypass Responses in Language Model Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2610.01165v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Layer interventions are widely used to probe the internal organization of language models, yet most analyses examine a single training checkpoint even though model representations and computations evolve throughout pretraining. This leaves open which depth-dependent intervention responses reflect persistent organization and which are transient consequences of training. We study this question using single-block identity bypass on fixed teacher-forced contexts across five released trajectories and 11 model-domain combinations. We find that block-bypass responses retain recognizable depth ordering while their magnitudes redistribute: nearby checkpoints preserve stronger rank correspondence than distant ones, and large changes concentrate at positions that recur across text samples and transfer across evaluation domains. translated_title: 语言模型预训练中块旁路响应变化之下的持久深度排序
translated_abstract: 层干预被广泛用于探测语言模型的内部组织结构，然而尽管模型的表示与计算在整个预训练过程中不断演化，大多数分析却只考察单一的训练检查点。这就留下了一个悬而未决的问题：哪些依赖深度的干预响应反映了持久的组织结构，哪些又只是训练过程中的瞬态结果。我们在五个已发布的训练轨迹和11个模型-领域组合上，通过对固定的教师强制上下文施加单块恒等旁路来研究这一问题。我们发现，块旁路响应在幅度重新分布的同时仍保持可辨识的深度排序：相邻检查点之间比相距较远的检查点保持更强的秩对应关系，而大幅变化集中在跨文本样本反复出现且可跨评估领域迁移的位置上。受控实验进一步表明，自然旁路效应的变化无法被归结为单一的下游（此处摘要原文截断）
tldr: 本文通过在多个预训练轨迹上施加单块恒等旁路干预，发现块旁路响应的幅度虽在训练中重新分布，但其深度排序始终保持可辨识，揭示了语言模型预训练中深度组织结构的持久性。
en_tdlr: By applying single-block identity bypass interventions across multiple pretraining trajectories, this paper shows that block-bypass responses retain recognizable depth ordering even as their magnitudes redistribute, revealing the persistence of depth-dependent organization throughout language model pretraining.
